intro.fallback: Pain summons two more bodies — the Preta Path and the Human Path.

Jiraiya is shocked beyond his wits to see three Rinnegan wielders before him; Pain decides to take advantage of the situation by having his Human Path rush towards Jiraiya, only for Jiraiya to give him a roundhouse kick...
Fukasaku uses a smoke bomb while Jiraiya unleashes his senjutsu-influenced Hair Needle Senbon, which Pain is able to block by summoning a Giant Panda.

name.fallback: In Attendance, the Six Paths of Pain

text.fallback: Head out: In Attendance, the Six Paths of Pain

outro.fallback: Jiraiya attempts to destroy the three Paths using his Sage Art: Goemon, a cooperation ninjutsu used alongside the Two Great Sage Toads, only for the Paths to be unscathed.
Amazed at how they were able to escape its effects, Jiraiya tries to destroy the Preta Path with an Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan; however, the Path proceeds to absorb the technique and render it useless.
